title: 第二十二章 静水藏微澜，旧影引新踪
content_zh:
夜色如水，晚风拂过长长的青石街巷。

    目送萧聿辞的马车缓缓消失在夜色尽头，沈清鸢立在相府朱红大门前，静静站了许久。

    连日紧绷的弦骤然松弛，周身是久违的松弛安宁，可她心底深处，依旧残留着一丝极淡的敏锐警觉。

    大仇得报，风波落尽，太子废黜，柳氏流放，后宅朝堂再无死敌。

    可她清楚，世间从无真正彻底的风平浪静。

    前世覆灭来得猝不及防，今生一路走来，越是安稳之时，越容易藏着隐匿暗流。

    “小姐，夜凉了，回院吧。”春桃轻声提醒。

    沈清鸢微微颔首，转身踏入府中。

    整座相府今夜格外热闹，下人们脸上都带着松弛的笑意，往来行走轻快利落。压在相府头顶十几年的阴云彻底散去，往后便是坦途。

    回到汀兰院，屋内烛火暖柔。

    沈清鸢坐在妆台前，抬手取下鬓边玉簪，目光无意间扫过妆匣最底层，一枚小小的、陈旧的墨玉吊坠静静躺在角落。

    这是她生母遗留的贴身旧物，质地温润，色泽暗沉，看上去平平无奇，多年来她只当是寻常配饰，从未深究。

    可今夜烛火映照之下，玉佩内侧，竟隐隐透出一丝极淡的金色纹路，细碎、隐秘，不细看根本无从察觉。

    沈清鸢心头微动，伸手取出玉佩，指尖细细摩挲内侧纹路。

    纹路古朴晦涩，绝非寻常民间雕工，反倒带着几分皇家宗族独有的图腾形制。

    她眉心轻轻蹙起。

    母亲出身书香世家，并非权贵宗族，一生安稳温婉，从未涉足朝堂深宫，为何会持有这般带着隐秘图腾的玉佩？

    从前被后宅争斗、朝堂风波缠身，她无暇细究生母过往，如今所有恩怨了结，这枚静静躺了十几年的旧玉佩，骤然浮出疑点。

    “春桃。”

    “奴婢在。”

    “你可记得，母亲当年出嫁，可有什么隐秘旧事、或是未曾提及的亲友？”

    春桃仔细回想半晌，轻轻摇头：“回小姐，老夫人从前提过，主母家世清白，父母皆是教书文士，无权贵亲友、无隐秘过往，一生平淡安稳，唯独身子孱弱，早早病逝。”
content_en:
The night is like water, and the evening breeze blows through the long bluestone streets.

Watching Xiao Yuci's carriage slowly disappear at the end of the night, Shen Qingyuan stood in front of the vermilion gate of the Prime Minister's Mansion and stood quietly for a long time.

The strings that had been tense for days suddenly relaxed, and her whole body was filled with a long-lost sense of relaxation and tranquility, but deep in her heart, there was still a faint trace of keen vigilance.

The great revenge was avenged, the storm was over, the prince was deposed, the Liu family was exiled, and there were no more mortal enemies in the back house and the court.

But she knew that there was never truly complete peace in the world.

The destruction of the previous life came unexpectedly. Along the way in this life, the more stable the situation, the easier it is to hide the hidden undercurrent.

"Miss, the night is getting cold, please go back to the hospital." Chuntao reminded softly.

Shen Qingyuan nodded slightly, turned around and stepped into the mansion.

The entire Prime Minister's Mansion was particularly lively tonight. The servants all had relaxed smiles on their faces and walked briskly and neatly.The dark clouds that have been weighing on the prime minister's head for more than ten years have completely dissipated, and the road ahead will be smooth.

Returning to Tinglan Courtyard, the candlelight in the house was warm and soft.

Shen Qingyuan sat in front of the dressing table, raised her hand to remove the jade hairpin from her temples, and glanced at the bottom of the dressing box inadvertently. A small, old black jade pendant lay quietly in the corner.

This was an old personal item left behind by her birth mother. It had a warm texture and dull color, and looked ordinary. Over the years, she had only regarded it as an ordinary accessory and never looked into it.

But tonight, under the candlelight, there was a trace of very faint golden lines on the inside of the jade pendant. It was so fine and secret that it was impossible to detect it unless you looked closely.

Shen Qingyuan's heart moved slightly, and she stretched out her hand to take out the jade pendant, and carefully rubbed the inner lines with her fingertips.

The texture is simple and obscure, definitely not an ordinary folk carving, but rather has a totem shape unique to the royal clan.

She frowned slightly.

My mother came from a scholarly family, not a powerful family. She had been stable and gentle throughout her life and had never set foot in the palace. Why did she possess such a jade pendant with a secret totem?

In the past, she was plagued by fights in the back house and turmoil in the court, and she had no time to study her biological mother's past. Now that all the grudges have been settled, doubts about this old jade pendant that had been lying quietly for more than ten years suddenly surfaced.

"Chuntao."

"My slave is here."

"Do you remember that when your mother got married, did she have any secret past events or relatives and friends that she never mentioned?"

Chuntao thought about it carefully for a while, then shook her head gently: "Miss, the old lady once said that my mistress had a clean family background. Her parents were both teachers and scribes. She had no powerful relatives or friends, and no secret past. She had a plain and stable life, but she was weak and died of an illness early."
